name: @workspace/tool-logic-qr
description: The QR Code tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/qr.md): the mode, capacity and messages of a text, the code's SVG, the Wi-Fi string and its parsing — pure; making a code with `qr` (make.ts) and reading codes in pixels with `qr/decode.js` (read.ts), each in a module of its own so a page loads neither until it needs it. Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
